title: The Algebraic Connectivity and Laplacian Spectral Radius of Token Graphs
summary: For a graph $G=(V,E)$ of order $n$ and an integer $k$ between $1$ and $\lfloor\frac{n}{2}\rfloor$, its token graph $F_k(G)$ is the graph whose vertices consist of the $\binom{n}{k}$ $k$-subsets of $V$, and two vertices of $F_k(G)$ are adjacent whenever their symmetric difference is an edge in $E$. It was found that the algebraic connectivity of a graph is greater than or equal to that of its token graph, while the Laplacian spectral radius of a graph is less than or equal to that of its token graph.
